title: EX13 · Real experiment replay · Visual enhancement

bookmarks.title: A root is actually placed
bookmarks.text: Two paid work rounds place one real root in a persistent trial plot. Propagation and future food remain unverified.

bookmarks.title: A material trial can fail usefully
bookmarks.text: Sol consumes 0.1 moss in a real press trial. It fails the tested load and reveals a bounded material response; this is not evidence of a usable bed.

bookmarks.title: Work completes, the problem remains
bookmarks.text: Lin moves loose cover within a small footprint. Conserved residues remain, so the complete planting footprint is still unsuitable. Paid work is not a success reward.

bookmarks.title: From a sample to a physical arrangement
bookmarks.text: Sol completes two paid placement rounds using 0.9 owned moss. Actual loose ground portions persist; coverage, comfort and resting benefits remain unproven.

bookmarks.title: Real material moves, compatibility stays open
bookmarks.text: Lin completes a paid transfer of 0.04 loose residue to a checked adjacent receiver. The material persists at its real destination; this step does not certify planting suitability.

bookmarks.title: Earlier work supports a later operation
bookmarks.text: After actual cover removal and residue transfer, Lin completes the separately learned compatibility adapter and places one conserved root. The earlier surface remains linked to the trial; propagation and food yield are still unverified.

bookmarks.title: Information travels through an actual message
bookmarks.text: After Moss reports its own remaining residue at round43, Lin sends its observed transfer and placement results. This is real communication, with uncertainty about viability and yield retained; it does not transfer mastery or material.

bookmarks.title: A real loose wrap, not a strength claim
bookmarks.text: After paid geometry observation, Lin positions the actual two branches and whole vine, then completes a loose wrap. Material leaves inventory and persists at the worksite. No calibrated force, useful joint or wellbeing benefit has been established.

bookmarks.title: Recovery conserves the original material
bookmarks.text: Following a separate inspection, Lin pays for local unwrapping and retrieves the same 0.9 vine and two branch units. The temporary arrangement is removed; no replacement stock or strength restoration is supplied.

bookmarks.title: A real contact changes the specimen
bookmarks.text: After actual stone gathering and a failed reach check, Lin completes two paid stone contacts. A small interior region is exposed in the same conserved specimen; the tool has bounded recorded wear. No additional edible stock or safety conclusion is created.

bookmarks.title: Reuse still needs personal work and observation
bookmarks.text: Moss gathers its own stone at round171, performs two paid contacts at178–179, then inspects the actual exposed region at180. The source-specific implementation reuses the earlier contact method; neither code reuse nor exposure establishes food safety, transferable knowledge or dietary benefit.

bookmarks.title: A chosen trial precedes actual food use
bookmarks.text: Moss separately authorizes and swallows 0.1 of an actually collected apple, leaving 0.9. Its private immediate record shows satiety +1 and health change 0, not general safety. Moss then chooses further collection at265 and a real two-apple meal at266 (+20 nutrition). The food profile already existed; the new interface supplies a conserved personal trial, not free food or new nutrition.
